messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up - Prospect NovaLedger wants a quick POC. Requirements: SAML SSO + SCIM sync, collapse multiple IdP groups into single Redwood roles, strict domain-only invites. Can we confirm technical fit and any production blockers?

ara-solutions: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP/SP init). Need IdP metadata XML, cert, NameID format. Group collapse options: (A) Accept redwood:role SAML attribute from IdP, (B) Provision groups via SCIM and map multiple group names to one role in Console. For POC recommend SCIM mapping so they can adjust without IdP changes.

ben-eng: SCIM details: /scim/v2/Users, /scim/v2/Groups, PATCH supported for membership. Bulk create up to 150 users per request. Group changes are eventually consistent; role cache TTL ~30-60s on Hosted. If they need instant effect consider Dedicated with lower cache TTL.

kai-security: Security notes: we require TLS1.2+, signed assertions RSA-SHA256. Assertion encryption supported (ask if they need it). SCIM over HTTPS with OAuth bearer token by default; mTLS available on Dedicated/Private. For domain enforcement we use DNS TXT verification + enforced email domain allowlist.

ara-solutions: Pricing note: Hosted metered (per-active-user + provisioning API calls). Dedicated includes provisioning allowance and predictable monthly cost. Need their POC user count to give examples.

sam-sales: POC numbers: 120 users. Ask: any edge-case blockers for merging groups (e.g., duplicate user IDs across IdP sources)?

ben-eng: If same user exists in multiple IdP groups we dedupe by primary identifier (email or internal user id). Recommend consistent nameID/email from IdP. If they have multiple user stores, advise to normalize upstream.

ticket-bot: [automated] Created ticket NOVA-POC-917 and attached SAML/SCIM checklist.

sam-sales: Action items: @ben-eng prepare 1-pg runbook (ACS, entityID, sample SAML attr map + SCIM examples), @kai-security produce questionnaire answers and domain verification steps, @ara-solutions draft hosted vs dedicated pricing bullets. Target: Tue EOD. I'll send to buyer once internal review done.

ara-solutions: ack :thumbsup:

ben-eng: I'll add a small SCIM example to the runbook:

POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{ "userName": "t.jones@novaledger.com", "name": {"givenName":"Tara","familyName":"Jones"}, "emails": [{"value":"t.jones@novaledger.com","primary":true}] }

kai-security: I'll include guidance on token rotation (recommend 90 days) and point them to https://redwood.ai/security/sso-scim.

sam-sales: Thanks team, will loop in buyer after runbook ready.
